metadata.title: Container Secrets Management

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring that secrets used by containerized workloads are protected from exposure, injected securely at runtime, and subject to controlled lifecycle management.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Containerized application secrets, runtime injection mechanisms, environment variables, metadata APIs, and secrets distribution interfaces.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for protecting secrets consumed by containerized workloads through runtime injection, lifecycle control, and exposure prevention.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Container secrets management assumes a trusted orchestration control plane for secure injection and enforcement.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Secrets handling and runtime exposure risks in container environments.

metadata.remarks: Container Secrets Management defines trust properties ensuring that secrets used by containerized workloads are never embedded in images, are injected at runtime through controlled mechanisms, and are protected against inadvertent or malicious exposure during execution.

components.title: Runtime Secret Injection
components.description: Secrets are injected into containerized workloads at runtime and are never embedded within container images.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Discovery of credentials embedded in container images or exposed at runtime.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation of secrets from container images and static configuration artifacts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protection of authentication secrets used by containerized workloads.
Secure management of cryptographic keys and secrets at runtime.

components.title: Container Secret Lifecycle Control
components.description: Secrets used by containerized workloads have defined rotation, revocation, and expiration semantics.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Continued abuse of long-lived or stale secrets used by container workloads.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Defined rotation and revocation of secrets used by containerized workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Management of secret lifecycle including rotation and expiration.
Configuration settings for secret lifecycle behaviors are defined and enforced.

components.title: Secret Exposure Prevention
components.description: Controls preventing secrets from leaking through logs, environment variables, metadata services, or diagnostics interfaces.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Extraction of secrets via logs, environment variables, or workload metadata interfaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Prevention of secret disclosure through runtime artifacts and observability paths.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protection against unauthorized disclosure of sensitive information at runtime.
Monitoring for inadvertent disclosure of secrets in logs or audit records.
